Create a chat completion with JWT authentication.

Supports two modes:
1. JWT Authentication (preferred): Extract user context from WorkOS JWT token
2. Legacy Mode: Extract user context from request metadata (backward compatibility)

Priority: JWT authentication > metadata

post.description:
Generate embeddings using Vertex AI.

OpenAI-compatible endpoint that supports:
- Single or batch embedding generation (up to 100 inputs)
- Task-type optimization (RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT, RETRIEVAL_QUERY, etc.)
- Configurable output dimensions (768, 1536, or 3072)
- Pre-normalized embeddings for 3072 dimensions

Args:
    request: Embedding request with input text(s) and options
    authenticated_user: Optional authenticated user (for logging/analytics)
    embedding_service: Vertex AI embedding service

Returns:
    EmbeddingResponse with embeddings and usage information

Uploaded files are stored on disk and metadata is returned to the caller.
